model: Extended-support beta model for attention sensitivity
description: Uses an extended-support beta distribution with observations censored to the interval from 0 to 1. Exact values of 0 and 1 are supported.
settings_note: Default settings, shown for reference. This JSON is documentation; editing it does not configure a run.
model_seed_rule: random_seed + 10000 + 101 * fold (fold 0 is the full-control fit)

fold_assignment.method: Outcome-blind grouped five-fold covariate balance, excluding response and FSIQ
